# GBM ECM Analysis

## RNAseq ECM Analysis

To look at the gene expression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in CGGA data sets. 

### Library

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(readxl)
```
### Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp

Data that are already downloaded are not downloaded again. Chunks are skipped using , eval = FALSE in chunk. 

#### Download mRNAseq_693 data

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Download expression data from STAR+RSEM (FPKM Value) 
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

# Download clinical meta data
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693_clinical&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

```

### Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 


Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM.

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 metadata
cgga693_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 metadata
cgga325_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# Filter CGGA-693: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga693_meta_gbm <- cgga693_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")

# Filter CGGA-325: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga325_meta_gbm <- cgga325_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")
```

The meta data shows many columns describing the phenotype of each sample. Within the meta data, irradiation status is listed as 0 or 1. Gene expression profile of ECM genes should be analyzed between recurrent tumors that received irradiation and tumors that did not. This may give insight into irradiation induced ECM change. 

### Add filters to gene expression data

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 gene expression data
cgga693_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 gene expression data
cgga325_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#### Filter expression data using filtered meta data

There is a problem using select() function, so the code below specifies to use dplyr 

```{r}
# cgga 693 filter
ids_693 <- intersect(colnames(cgga693_expr)[-1], cgga693_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga693_expr_filt <- cgga693_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_693))

cgga693_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga693_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_693) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_693, CGGA_ID))

# cgga 325 filter
ids_325 <- intersect(colnames(cgga325_expr)[-1], cgga325_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga325_expr_filt <- cgga325_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_325))

cgga325_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga325_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_325) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_325, CGGA_ID))
```

### Load non-glioma control to environment

```{r}
# Load the control expression data
control_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA_RNAseq_Control_20.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


### Load GO ECM Gene set

```{r}
# ECM genes from GO:0031012 

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

ecm_genes_raw <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "name_1006"),
  filters    = "go",
  values     = "GO:0031012",  
  mart       = ensembl
)

# Clean to unique, non-empty human symbols
ecm_genes_tbl <- ecm_genes_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol), nzchar(hgnc_symbol)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = FALSE)

# Final for filtering expression
ecm_gene_list <- unique(ecm_genes_tbl$hgnc_symbol)
```

### Merge all Genes and Data
```{r}
# ---- Harmonize control column name (as you already do later) ----
control_expr <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene_Name = gene_name)

# ---- Deduplicate genes within each cohort BEFORE merging ----
cgga693_all <- cgga693_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

cgga325_all <- cgga325_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

control_all <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Intersect to common genes across all three (still ALL genes) ----
common_genes_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  cgga693_all$Gene_Name,
  cgga325_all$Gene_Name,
  control_all$Gene_Name
))

cgga693_all_common <- cgga693_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

cgga325_all_common <- cgga325_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

control_all_common <- control_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

# ---- Ensure unique sample IDs across cohorts (add suffixes only if needed) ----
samp_693 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga693_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_325 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga325_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_ctl <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")

overlap_693_325 <- intersect(samp_693, samp_325)
overlap_693_ctl  <- intersect(samp_693, samp_ctl)
overlap_325_ctl  <- intersect(samp_325, samp_ctl)

if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga693_all_common)[match(samp_693, colnames(cgga693_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_693, "_693")
}
if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga325_all_common)[match(samp_325, colnames(cgga325_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_325, "_325")
}
if (length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(control_all_common)[match(samp_ctl, colnames(control_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_ctl, "_CTRL")
}

# ---- Merge ALL genes by Gene_Name ----
merged_expr_all <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::inner_join(x, y, by = "Gene_Name"),
  list(cgga693_all_common, cgga325_all_common, control_all_common)
)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged_expr_all$Gene_Name))
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(colnames(merged_expr_all))) == 0)

```

##### Merge meta data

```{r}
# --- MERGE META DATA (with survival) ---


# 'merged_expr_all' already built above
merged_samples <- colnames(merged_expr_all)[-1]

# Base meta frames (Group/Cohort)
meta693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group  = dplyr::if_else(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA693"
  )

meta325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group  = dplyr::if_else(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA325"
  )

ctl_ids <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")
metaCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  group  = "Control",
  cohort = "Control"
)

# Helper: append suffix ONLY if present in merged sample IDs
add_suffix_if_needed <- function(df, suffix) {
  needs_suffix <- any(grepl(paste0(suffix, "$"), merged_samples))
  if (needs_suffix) df$sample_id <- paste0(df$sample_id, suffix)
  df
}

meta693 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta693, "_693")
meta325 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta325, "_325")
metaCTL <- add_suffix_if_needed(metaCTL, "_CTRL")

# Combine base meta and keep only samples that exist in merged expression
sample_meta_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta693, meta325, metaCTL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% merged_samples) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add radio/chemo
meta693_extra <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

meta325_extra <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

metaCTL_extra <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  Radio_status = NA_integer_,
  Chemo_status = NA_integer_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# ---- NEW: bring in survival (OS_days, OS_event) ----
surv693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

surv325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

survCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  OS_days   = NA_real_,
  OS_event  = NA_real_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# Merge everything into sample_meta_all
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(meta693_extra, meta325_extra, metaCTL_extra), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(surv693, surv325, survCTL), by = "sample_id")

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(setequal(sample_meta_all$sample_id, merged_samples))
message("Survival rows with data: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_days)), 
        " | events present: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_event)))

# (Optional) a convenience in years for plotting tables
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS_years = ifelse(!is.na(OS_days), OS_days / 365.25, NA_real_))

```

### Normalization and QC

```{r}
# Wide genes x samples matrix
expr_mat_all <- merged_expr_all %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene_Name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Align meta row order to columns exactly
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(expr_mat_all), sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(sample_meta_all$sample_id, colnames(expr_mat_all)))

# Log2 transform for QC/visualization
expr_log2_all <- log2(expr_mat_all + 1)

# Long table for QC plots
expr_all_long <- expr_log2_all %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene_Name, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group  = factor(group,  levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control", "CGGA693", "CGGA325"))
  )

# QC: per-sample distributions
ggplot(expr_all_long, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "ALL genes: per-sample log2(FPKM+1) distributions",
       x = "Sample", y = "log2 expression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

```
#### Batch effect correction

```{r}
# Indices
idx_tumor   <- which(sample_meta_all$group != "Control")
idx_control <- which(sample_meta_all$group == "Control")

expr_tumor_all   <- expr_log2_all[, idx_tumor, drop = FALSE]
expr_control_all <- expr_log2_all[, idx_control, drop = FALSE]

tumor_meta <- sample_meta_all[idx_tumor, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM","rGBM")))

batch_tumor  <- factor(tumor_meta$cohort)
design_tumor <- model.matrix(~ group, data = tumor_meta)

expr_tumor_adj_all <- limma::removeBatchEffect(expr_tumor_all,
                                               batch = batch_tumor,
                                               design = design_tumor)

# Recombine (keep original sample order)
expr_adj_all <- expr_log2_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_tumor]   <- expr_tumor_adj_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_control] <- expr_control_all

# Quick PCA check before/after
keep_genes <- apply(expr_log2_all, 1, var) > 0
X_before <- t(expr_log2_all[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])
X_after  <- t(expr_adj_all[keep_genes,  , drop = FALSE])

pca_before <- prcomp(X_before, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_after  <- prcomp(X_after,  center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

ve_b <- (pca_before$sdev^2) / sum(pca_before$sdev^2)
ve_a <- (pca_after$sdev^2)  / sum(pca_after$sdev^2)

df_b <- as.data.frame(pca_before$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "Before (log2 FPKM)")

df_a <- as.data.frame(pca_after$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "After (tumor-only adj)")

group_cols <- c(Control = "grey40", GBM = "#1f77b4", rGBM = "#d62728")

ggplot(df_b, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA BEFORE batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_b[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_b[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

ggplot(df_a, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA AFTER tumor-only batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_a[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_a[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

```

### DEG Analysis pre-Gene list

#### Volcano

```{r}
# ---- Volcano (ALL genes) — rGBM vs Control ----
# Needs: expr_adj_all (genes x samples, batch-adjusted log2(FPKM+1))
#        sample_meta_all (columns: sample_id, group with "Control" and "rGBM")

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_all) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Subset to rGBM + Control and design (Control baseline)
idx_keep <- which(sample_meta_all$group %in% c("Control","rGBM"))
stopifnot(length(idx_keep) > 1)

expr_rc <- expr_adj_all[, idx_keep, drop = FALSE]
meta_rc <- sample_meta_all[idx_keep, , drop = FALSE]
meta_rc$group <- factor(meta_rc$group, levels = c("Control","rGBM"))

design  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = meta_rc)
colnames(design) <- levels(meta_rc$group)
contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_Control = rGBM - Control, levels = design)

# 2) Limma on ALL genes
fit  <- limma::lmFit(expr_rc, design)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- limma::topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

res_tbl <- res %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B)

# 3) Prep volcano data (ALL genes; no filtering)
volc_df <- res_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    lfc      = logFC,
    padj     = adj.P.Val,
    neglog10 = -log10(adj.P.Val)
  )

# 4) Thresholds and status
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 1.0

volc_df <- volc_df %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
    padj < padj_cut & lfc >  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
    padj < padj_cut & lfc < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
    TRUE                             ~ "NS"
  ))

# Labels: top 20 by |lfc| (feel free to change n)
labs <- volc_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene)

# 5) Plot
p_volc_all <- ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, gene %in% labs),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "All genes: rGBM vs Control (batch-adjusted, limma on ALL genes)",
    subtitle = "Contrast = rGBM − Control",
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p~value)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
         panel.border = element_blank()
  )

print(p_volc_all)

# 6) Save outputs
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/All_DEG"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "Volcano_AllGenes_rGBM_vs_Control_batchAdj.pdf"),
       p_volc_all, width = 6.8, height = 5.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

# Save the plot data and full DE table
write_csv(volc_df, file.path(outdir, "Volcano_AllGenes_rGBM_vs_Control_plotdata.csv"))
```

```{r}
# 1) Load your saved DE results
res_tbl <- read_csv("/Data/Outputs/All_DEG/DE_full_rGBM_vs_Control_allgenes_batchAdj.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2) Map SYMBOL → ENTREZ (required for gseGO)

                toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# 3) Join with DE results, keep unique ENTREZ

  inner_join(sym2ent, by = c("gene" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
  distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 4) Build ranked vector (t-statistic works well)
ranks <- rank_df$t
names(ranks) <- rank_df$ENTREZID
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

# Now ranks exists and you can continue
head(ranks)
```

```{r}
# ranks: named numeric vector (ENTREZ -> t-stat)
stopifnot(exists("ranks"))
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(1234)

# 1) GSEA without internal filtering
ego_full <- gseGO(
  geneList      = ranks,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "none",  # return raw p-values
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,       # keep everything
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 5000,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

# 2) Recompute BH FDR + prep table
df <- as.data.frame(ego_full) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    padj     = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
    padj_eps = pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)  # avoid zeros for plotting
  )


# Keep only positive NES, sort by NES desc, take top 5
topN  <- 6
df_top <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(NES)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = topN)

if (nrow(df_top) == 0) stop("No positively enriched pathways (NES > 0).")

# Bar plot version
p_nes <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(Description, NES))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue3", width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL,
       title = "GO BP GSEA — rGBM vs Control (Top 6 positive NES)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank())

print(p_nes)
```

#### Heatmap

```{r}
# --- STEP 1: Prep ECM heatmap inputs (matrix + annotations) ---

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_ecm"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_ecm) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Keep genes with some variance
gene_var <- apply(expr_adj_ecm, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
keep     <- gene_var > 0
mat_ecm  <- expr_adj_ecm[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) (Optional) Limit to top variable ECM genes for readability
top_var_n <- 150   # <- change if you want more/less genes
ord <- order(gene_var[keep], decreasing = TRUE)
if (length(ord) > top_var_n) ord <- ord[seq_len(top_var_n)]
mat_ecm <- mat_ecm[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# 3) Row-scale (Z-score) to emphasize relative patterns across samples
row_zscore <- function(x) {
  mu <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd <- apply(x, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sweep(sweep(x, 1, mu, "-"), 1, pmax(sd, .Machine$double.eps), "/")
}
H_ecm <- row_zscore(mat_ecm)

# 4) Column annotations (Group, Cohort, Radio/Chemo labels)
ann_col <- sample_meta_all |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id,
    Group   = factor(group,  levels = c("Control","GBM","rGBM")),
    Cohort  = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control","CGGA693","CGGA325")),
    Radio   = dplyr::case_when(Radio_status == 1 ~ "Treated",
                               Radio_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    Chemo   = dplyr::case_when(Chemo_status == 1 ~ "TMZ Treated",
                               Chemo_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  ) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")

# ensure order matches columns of H_ecm
ann_col <- ann_col[colnames(H_ecm), , drop = FALSE]

# 5) Quick sanity prints
cat("ECM heatmap matrix dims (genes x samples):", nrow(H_ecm), "x", ncol(H_ecm), "\n")
table(ann_col$Group)
table(ann_col$Cohort)

# Objects created for next step:
# - H_ecm: row-scaled matrix (genes x samples)
# - ann_col: data.frame for column annotations (rows = samples)

```

#### Volcano

```{r}
# --- Volcano: ECM genes, rGBM vs Control ---

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_ecm"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_ecm) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Subset to rGBM + Control
keep <- sample_meta_all$group %in% c("Control","rGBM")
X    <- expr_adj_ecm[, keep, drop = FALSE]
mta  <- droplevels(sample_meta_all[keep, ])
mta$group <- factor(mta$group, levels = c("Control","rGBM"))

# 2) limma (Control baseline)
design   <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = mta)
colnames(design) <- levels(mta$group)
contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_Control = rGBM - Control, levels = design)

fit  <- limma::lmFit(X, design)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- limma::topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH") |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B)

# 3) Prep data
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 0.5      # ECM effects can be modest; tweak if desired

volc_df <- res |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    lfc      = logFC,
    padj     = adj.P.Val,
    neglog10 = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    status   = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < padj_cut & logFC >  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
      adj.P.Val < padj_cut & logFC < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE                                    ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# Label top genes by |lfc|
labs <- volc_df |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(lfc))) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene)

# 4) Plot
p_volc <- ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, gene %in% labs),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "ECM genes: rGBM vs Control",
    subtitle = "limma on batch-adjusted log2(FPKM+1) | Contrast = rGBM − Control",
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p~value)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank())

print(p_volc)

# 5) Save outputs
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/ECM_DEG"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "Volcano_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control.pdf"),
       p_volc, width = 6.8, height = 5.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

readr::write_csv(volc_df, file.path(outdir, "Volcano_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control_plotdata.csv"))
readr::write_csv(res,     file.path(outdir, "DE_full_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control.csv"))

# Quick counts for the log
print(table(volc_df$status))

```

```{r}
genes_target <- toupper(c("COL1A1", "COL3A1"))
```

```{r}
med <- median(meta_r$collagen_score, na.rm = TRUE)

meta_r$collagen_group <- ifelse(meta_r$collagen_score >= med, "Collagen_High", "Collagen_Low")
meta_r$collagen_group <- factor(meta_r$collagen_group, levels = c("Collagen_Low","Collagen_High"))

table(meta_r$collagen_group)
summary(meta_r$collagen_score)
```

##### COL high vs low GSEA

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DE: ALL genes | rGBM only | Collagen High vs Low (ADJUSTED)
# Output object: de_col_low_high
# ============================================================

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"), exists("meta_r"))

# rGBM samples only
idx_r <- which(sample_meta_all$group == "rGBM")
X_r   <- expr_adj_all[, idx_r, drop = FALSE]

# Align metadata
meta_r <- meta_r %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(X_r), sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(meta_r$sample_id, colnames(X_r)))

# Covariates
meta_r2 <- meta_r %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    collagen_group = factor(collagen_group, levels = c("Collagen_Low","Collagen_High")),
    cohort        = factor(cohort),
    Radio_status  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Radio_status)),
    Chemo_status  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Chemo_status))
  )

# Keep complete cases
keep_cc <- complete.cases(
  meta_r2[, c("collagen_group","cohort","Radio_status","Chemo_status")]
)

meta_cc <- droplevels(meta_r2[keep_cc, ])
X_cc    <- X_r[, keep_cc, drop = FALSE]

cat("Samples used:", nrow(meta_cc), "\n")

# Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + collagen_group + cohort + Radio_status + Chemo_status,
  data = meta_cc
)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

# Identify collagen coefficient
coef_name <- grep("^collagen_groupCollagen_High$", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(coef_name) == 1)

# Limma
fit  <- limma::lmFit(X_cc, design)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(fit)

# Extract DE
de_col_low_high <- limma::topTable(
  fit2,
  coef = coef_name,
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val)

# Save
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GO_COLhigh_vs_low_rGBM"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

readr::write_csv(
  de_col_low_high,
  file.path(outdir, "DE_ALLGENES_rGBM_CollagenHigh_vs_Low_ADJUSTED.csv")
)

# Sanity
summary(de_col_low_high$logFC)
table(de_col_low_high$adj.P.Val < 0.05)

```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# GSEA (GO BP): Top 10 POSITIVELY enriched
# (i.e., enriched in Collagen_High)
# ==========================================

stopifnot(exists("de_col_low_high"))

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GO_COLhigh_vs_low_rGBM"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

de_use <- de_col_low_high

# SYMBOL -> ENTREZ
sym2ent <- clusterProfiler::bitr(
  de_use$gene,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)

rank_df <- de_use %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(sym2ent, by = c("gene" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Rank by t-stat (positive = higher in Collagen_High)
ranks <- rank_df$t
names(ranks) <- rank_df$ENTREZID
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(1234)
gsea_bp <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
  geneList      = ranks,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,     # keep everything, we'll filter ourselves
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 5000,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

gsea_bp_df <- as.data.frame(gsea_bp)

# ---- keep only positively enriched (NES > 0), then top 10 ----
gsea_pos10 <- gsea_bp_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, dplyr::desc(NES)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

# Save tables
readr::write_csv(gsea_bp_df,  file.path(outdir, "GSEA_GO_BP_ALL_rGBM_CollagenHigh_vs_Low_ADJUSTED.csv"))
readr::write_csv(gsea_pos10,  file.path(outdir, "GSEA_GO_BP_TOP10_PosNES_CollagenHigh_ADJUSTED.csv"))

# Plot only the top 10 positive NES terms
p_pos10 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  gsea_pos10,
  ggplot2::aes(x = NES, y = stats::reorder(Description, NES))
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Top 10 GO BP terms enriched in Collagen High (rGBM)",
    subtitle = "Positive NES only (Collagen_High > Collagen_Low) | ranked by BH FDR then NES",
    x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                 panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank())

print(p_pos10)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(outdir, "GSEA_GO_BP_TOP10_PosNES_barplot_ADJUSTED.pdf"),
  p_pos10,
  width = 9,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

# Quick view in console
gsea_pos10 %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, pvalue, p.adjust) %>% print(n = 10)
```

## GeoMx Data

### WT Primary vs Rec GBM Data

Hasan had already performed the QC on these data. To analyze the data further, I downloaded his Sample_Annotation to serve as the meta data for this analysis. I downloaded the Log2-norm-counts for individual gene analysis across samples. Finally, I downloaded WT_DE_analysis to create volcano plot and heatmap. 


```{r}

# Read Excel sheet (default is first sheet) 
meta <- read_excel(meta_path)

```

```{r}

  filter(IDH == "WT")

# Preview result
glimpse(meta_wt)

```

```{r}
  filter(Dx == "GBM")

# Preview result
glimpse(meta_wt_gbm)

```

Now we have the Sample_ID for WT-GBM, so we will apply this filtering for the Log2-norm-counts. This will give per sample gene expression for gene-specific analysis.

```{r}
# ---- Normalize counts colnames (drop ".dcc"), then filter ----

# Ensure tibble for dplyr compatibility
counts <- tibble::as_tibble(counts)

# 1) Strip the ".dcc" suffix from sample columns (leave gene column alone)
nm <- names(counts)
if (length(nm) >= 2) {
  nm[-1] <- sub("\\.dcc$", "", nm[-1], perl = TRUE)
  names(counts) <- nm
}

# 2) Match to metadata Sample_IDs

# Quick diagnostics

missing <- setdiff(samples_to_keep, names(counts))

message("Matched samples: ", length(found), " / ", length(samples_to_keep))
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  message("Not found (after stripping .dcc): ", paste(head(missing, 10), collapse = ", "),
          ifelse(length(missing) > 10, " ...", ""))
}

# 3) Filter to gene column + matched sample columns
gene_col <- names(counts)[1]
counts_filtered <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(gene_col), any_of(found))

# Peek
dim(counts_filtered)
head(counts_filtered[, 1:min(6, ncol(counts_filtered))])
```

#### Collagen Expression Across Tumor Type and Patient ID

```{r}
# ---- COL1A1 / COL3A1: Paired Pri vs Rec comparison (duplicate-safe) ----

# 0) Pick genes and confirm they exist
genes_target <- c("COL1A1", "COL3A1")
genes_found  <- intersect(genes_target, unique(counts_long$Gene))
if (length(genes_found) == 0) stop("Neither COL1A1 nor COL3A1 found in counts_long$Gene.")
if (length(genes_found) < length(genes_target)) {
  message("Missing genes: ", paste(setdiff(genes_target, genes_found), collapse = ", "))
}

# 1) Merge Pri/Rec and PtID info; keep only rows with both present
df_expr <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% genes_found) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_wt_gbm %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Pri_Rec, PtID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Pri_Rec) & !is.na(PtID))

# 2) Keep only patients that have BOTH Pri and Rec in this subset
paired_pts <- df_expr %>%
  dplyr::distinct(PtID, Pri_Rec) %>%
  dplyr::count(PtID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%             # has at least 2 statuses (Pri & Rec)
  dplyr::pull(PtID)

df_paired <- df_expr %>%
  dplyr::filter(PtID %in% paired_pts)

# 3) (Key fix) Collapse duplicates within (Gene, PtID, Pri_Rec) to ONE value (mean)
df_paired_agg <- df_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, PtID, Pri_Rec) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(log2_expr = mean(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4) Paired t-test per gene, guarding against incomplete pairs
t_tbl_paired <- lapply(split(df_paired_agg, df_paired_agg$Gene), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Pri_Rec,
      values_from = log2_expr,
      values_fill = NA_real_
    )

  # Keep complete Pri–Rec pairs only
  wide_cc <- wide %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Pri) & !is.na(Rec))
  n_pairs <- nrow(wide_cc)

  if (n_pairs >= 2) {
    tt <- t.test(wide_cc$Pri, wide_cc$Rec, paired = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      Gene        = unique(d$Gene),
      n_pairs     = n_pairs,
      mean_Pri    = mean(wide_cc$Pri, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_Rec    = mean(wide_cc$Rec, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_delta  = mean(wide_cc$Rec - wide_cc$Pri, na.rm = TRUE), # Rec - Pri
      p_value     = tt$p.value,
      statistic   = unname(tt$statistic),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else if (n_pairs == 1) {
    data.frame(
      Gene        = unique(d$Gene),
      n_pairs     = n_pairs,
      mean_Pri    = wide_cc$Pri[1],
      mean_Rec    = wide_cc$Rec[1],
      mean_delta  = wide_cc$Rec[1] - wide_cc$Pri[1],
      p_value     = NA_real_,
      statistic   = NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    data.frame(
      Gene        = unique(d$Gene),
      n_pairs     = 0L,
      mean_Pri    = NA_real_,
      mean_Rec    = NA_real_,
      mean_delta  = NA_real_,
      p_value     = NA_real_,
      statistic   = NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene)

print(t_tbl_paired)

```

```{r}
# =========================
# Paired line plot (Pri vs Rec) for COL1A1 / COL3A1
# Requires: df_paired_agg from previous step (one value per Gene x PtID x Pri_Rec)
# =========================

# 1) Keep only complete Pri–Rec pairs per Gene x PtID
pairs_complete <- df_paired_agg %>%
  group_by(Gene, PtID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Pri_Rec) == 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Pri_Rec = factor(Pri_Rec, levels = c("Pri", "Rec")))

# 2) Compute paired t-test p-values (per gene) for annotation
t_tbl_paired <- pairs_complete %>%
  select(Gene, PtID, Pri_Rec, log2_expr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Pri_Rec, values_from = log2_expr, values_fill = NA_real_) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  do({
    dat <- .
    # guard: need at least 2 pairs to run a paired t-test
    if (nrow(dat) >= 2) {
      tt <- t.test(dat$Pri, dat$Rec, paired = TRUE)
      tibble(
        n_pairs    = nrow(dat),
        mean_delta = mean(dat$Rec - dat$Pri, na.rm = TRUE),
        p_value    = tt$p.value
      )
    } else {
      tibble(n_pairs = nrow(dat), mean_delta = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_lab = paste0(
    "Paired t-test p = ",
    ifelse(is.na(p_value), "NA", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = 1e-3))
  ))

# 3) Pick sensible y-positions for the p-value labels
lab_pos <- pairs_complete %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(t_tbl_paired, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(y = y_max + 0.05 * abs(y_max))

# 4) Colors (small, clear palette)
col_map <- c(Pri = "#1F78B4", Rec = "#E31A1C")

# 5) Plot
p_paired <- ggplot(pairs_complete, aes(x = Pri_Rec, y = log2_expr, group = PtID)) +
  # one line per patient
  geom_line(color = "gray60", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.7) +
  # points colored by condition
  geom_point(aes(color = Pri_Rec), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  # show condition means (optional, subtle)
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3.2, shape = 21,
               fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_map, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Paired Pri–Rec expression per patient (COL1A1 / COL3A1)",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(log[2]~normalized~expression)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  # p-value labels placed near the Rec side
  geom_text(
    data = lab_pos,
    aes(x = "Rec", y = y, label = p_lab),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, hjust = 1
  )

p_paired

```

```{r}
# 0) Pick genes and confirm they exist

# 1) Merge Tumor_Type info
df_expr <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% genes_found) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_wt_gbm %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Tumor_Type),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Tumor_Type))

# 2) Summary stats per group
expr_summary <- df_expr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, Tumor_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_log2 = mean(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log2 = sd(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_log2 = sd_log2 / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(expr_summary)

# 3) Statistical tests per gene
# If there are >2 tumor types → one-way ANOVA + Tukey post-hoc
# If only 2 types → Welch t-test
if (length(unique(df_expr$Tumor_Type)) > 2) {
  # ANOVA
  test_results <- df_expr %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
    dplyr::do({
      aov_res <- stats::aov(log2_expr ~ Tumor_Type, data = .)
      tidy <- broom::tidy(aov_res)
      tidy
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(term == "Tumor_Type")
  
  print(test_results)
  
  # Tukey post-hoc comparisons
  tukey_results <- df_expr %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
    dplyr::do({
      aov_res <- stats::aov(log2_expr ~ Tumor_Type, data = .)
      tk <- TukeyHSD(aov_res)
      broom::tidy(tk)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  print(tukey_results)

} else {
  # Welch t-test if only two Tumor_Type groups
  test_results <- df_expr %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      p_value = stats::t.test(log2_expr ~ Tumor_Type, data = ., var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
      mean_diff = diff(rev(tapply(log2_expr, Tumor_Type, mean, na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  print(test_results)
}

# 4) Visualization: box + jitter (per Tumor_Type)
col_map <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(length(unique(df_expr$Tumor_Type)), "Set2")

p_tumor_type <- ggplot(df_expr, aes(x = Tumor_Type, y = log2_expr, fill = Tumor_Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_map) +
  labs(
    title = "COL1A1 / COL3A1 log2-normalized expression across Tumor Types",
    x = "Tumor Type",
    y = expression(log[2]~normalized~expression)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

p_tumor_type
```

```{r}
# ---- COL1A1 / COL3A1: Unpaired Pri (GBM) vs Rec (rGBM) within Tumor_Type == "C" ----

# 0) Target genes (update to COL* block below if you want all collagens)
genes_target <- c("COL1A1", "COL3A1")
genes_found  <- base::intersect(genes_target, unique(counts_long$Gene))
if (length(genes_found) == 0) stop("No target COL genes found in counts_long$Gene.")
if (length(genes_found) < length(genes_target)) {
  message("Missing genes: ", paste(setdiff(genes_target, genes_found), collapse = ", "))
}

# 1) Merge Pri_Rec + Tumor_Type; keep only Tumor_Type == "C"
df_expr_C <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% genes_found) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_wt_gbm %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Pri_Rec, Tumor_Type),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Pri_Rec), !is.na(Tumor_Type), Tumor_Type == "C")

# 2) Summary stats per group (Pri/Rec)
expr_summary_C <- df_expr_C %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene, Pri_Rec) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n         = dplyr::n(),
    mean_log2 = mean(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log2   = sd(log2_expr,   na.rm = TRUE),
    se_log2   = sd_log2 / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(expr_summary_C)

# 3) Welch t-test per gene (unpaired)
tt_C <- df_expr_C %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value   = stats::t.test(log2_expr ~ Pri_Rec, data = ., var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
    mean_Pri  = mean(log2_expr[Pri_Rec == "Pri"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Rec  = mean(log2_expr[Pri_Rec == "Rec"], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta     = mean_Rec - mean_Pri,  # Rec - Pri
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_lab = paste0("Welch t-test p = ",
                               ifelse(is.na(p_value), "NA", format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = 1e-3))))
print(tt_C)

# 4) Choose y-positions for labels
lab_pos_C <- df_expr_C %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y_max = max(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tt_C, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y = y_max + 0.05 * abs(y_max))

# 5) Plot (box + jitter) for Tumor_Type == "C"
col_map <- c(Pri = "#1F78B4", Rec = "#E31A1C")

p_C <- ggplot(df_expr_C, aes(x = Pri_Rec, y = log2_expr, fill = Pri_Rec)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_map) +
  labs(
    title = "COL1A1 / COL3A1 expression in Tumor_Type = 'C' (Unpaired Pri vs Rec)",
    x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~normalized~expression)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_text(
    data = lab_pos_C,
    aes(x = "Rec", y = y, label = p_lab),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.2, hjust = 1
  )

p_C
```

```{r}
# ---- Filter for TGFb genes ----
tgfb_genes_found <- base::intersect(tgfb_gene_set, unique(counts_long$Gene))
message("Found ", length(tgfb_genes_found), " of ", length(tgfb_gene_set), " TGFb-related genes in dataset.")

# ---- Compute COL3A1 median and stratify ----
col3_expr <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene == "COL3A1") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, log2_expr)

col3_median <- median(col3_expr$log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE)

col3_groups <- col3_expr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(COL3A1_group = ifelse(log2_expr >= col3_median, "High", "Low"))

# ---- Merge group info ----
meta_with_col3 <- meta_wt_gbm %>%
  dplyr::left_join(col3_groups %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, COL3A1_group), by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(COL3A1_group))

# ---- Extract TGFb expression data ----
df_tgfb <- counts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% tgfb_genes_found) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_with_col3 %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID, COL3A1_group), by = "Sample_ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(COL3A1_group))

# ---- Welch t-tests: COL3A1 High vs Low ----
tt_tgfb <- df_tgfb %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value   = stats::t.test(log2_expr ~ COL3A1_group, data = ., var.equal = FALSE)$p.value,
    mean_High = mean(log2_expr[COL3A1_group == "High"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Low  = mean(log2_expr[COL3A1_group == "Low"],  na.rm = TRUE),
    delta     = mean_High - mean_Low,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(adj_p = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj_p)

print(tt_tgfb)
```

```{r}
# ---- Load Completed WT DEG Analysis ----
# File path
wt_deg_path <- "/Data/Inputs/WT_DE_analysis.csv"

# Read in the CSV
wt_deg <- read_csv(wt_deg_path)

# Quick structure check
glimpse(wt_deg)

# Optional: clean column names (replace spaces with underscores)
wt_deg <- wt_deg %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\s+", "_", .x))

# Preview first few rows
head(wt_deg)

```




```{r}
# ---- Volcano: Rec vs Pri from wt_deg ----

# 0) thresholds (tweak if you like)
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 1

# 1) Prepare data
# Assume Estimate currently encodes Pri vs Rec. Flip sign so it's Rec vs Pri.
df <- wt_deg %>%
  mutate(
    gene = coalesce(
      # try to guess a gene/symbol column; add/adjust if yours is different
      wt_deg$Gene %||% wt_deg$gene %||% wt_deg$SYMBOL %||% wt_deg$Symbol,
      as.character(seq_len(n()))  # fallback row index if no gene col
    ),
    lfc      = -Estimate,          # <-- flip to Rec vs Pri
    padj     = FDR,
    neglog10 = -log10(padj),
    status   = case_when(
      padj < padj_cut & lfc >  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
      padj < padj_cut & lfc < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE                              ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# 2) choose labels (top by |lfc| among significant)
labs <- df %>%
  filter(status != "NS") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  head(20)

# 3) plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(df, gene %in% labs),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rec vs Pri GBM — Differential Expression (WT subset)",
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change~"(Rec vs Pri)"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

```{r}
# ---- Collagen Heatmap: Pri vs Rec ----

# 1) Build expression matrix (genes as rownames)
gene_col <- names(counts_filtered)[1]
expr_mat <- counts_filtered %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = gene_col) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 2) Align metadata and order columns Pri -> Rec
meta_sub <- meta_wt_gbm %>%
  filter(Sample_ID %in% colnames(expr_mat)) %>%
  mutate(Pri_Rec = factor(Pri_Rec, levels = c("Pri","Rec"))) %>%
  arrange(Pri_Rec)

expr_mat <- expr_mat[, meta_sub$Sample_ID, drop = FALSE]

# 3) Select collagen genes (prefix "COL", case-insensitive)
collagen_genes <- rownames(expr_mat)[grepl("^COL", rownames(expr_mat), ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Keep only collagens present
mat_col <- expr_mat[intersect(rownames(expr_mat), collagen_genes), , drop = FALSE]

# 4) Drop rows with zero variance (pheatmap can't scale those)
var_ok <- apply(mat_col, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
mat_col <- mat_col[var_ok, , drop = FALSE]

# 5) Column annotation (Pri vs Rec)
ann_col <- data.frame(Pri_Rec = meta_sub$Pri_Rec)
rownames(ann_col) <- meta_sub$Sample_ID

# 6) Heatmap (row-scaled)
# Minimal, readable palette
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("#1f77b4", "white", "#d62728"))(101)

pheatmap(
  mat_col,
  scale           = "row",
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_cols    = FALSE,          # keep Pri -> Rec order
  annotation_col  = ann_col,
  show_colnames   = FALSE,
  fontsize_row    = 8,
  color           = pal,
  main            = "Collagen genes (row-scaled z-scores): Rec vs Pri GBM"
)
```
